choices.label: Did you not say you would come yesterday?

choices.label: This book is useful and belongs to me.
choices.feedback: This book is useful, but it is not mine. 可 can begin a contrasting clause, much like 可是. Here it links two claims: the book is useful, but ownership limits what the speaker can do with it.
